fusions.name: No Gap Between Bars
fusions.desc: Hooks a target up to 6 tiles away for 20 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Portcullis Row
fusions.desc: Drives a row of tines 6 tiles long into the ground for 8 seconds. It deals 26 damage, ignoring armour, to each enemy that crosses it and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Penned In
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds. They cannot be healed while it holds.

fusions.name: Latch Falls
fusions.desc: Every hit you land on an enemy builds a stack on it, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
